# Description

<!--
Summarize the change, why it is needed, and which example paths are affected.
If this updates docs-derived example code, the code in this repository should be the source of truth.
-->

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat`: New example, variant, feature, or capability
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix or behavioral correction
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation or README update
- [ ] `refactor`: Internal restructuring without intended behavior change
- [ ] `test`: Test, fixture, or attack-case update
- [ ] `build`: Dependency, packaging, or tooling change
- [ ] `ci`: Workflow or automation change
- [ ] `security`: Trust boundary, validation, or policy hardening
- [ ] `BREAKING CHANGE`: Intentional incompatible change
- [ ] `chore`: Other maintenance work

## Scope

- Example slug(s):
- Variant(s):
- Shared assets touched:
- Docs or tutorial pages that should sync from this change:

## Related issues / discussions / resources

Examples:
- Closes #123

## Pre-merge checklist

- [ ] I have read and followed [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](./.github/CONTRIBUTING.md) and [`CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md`](./.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [ ] This pull request is scoped to one logical change.
- [ ] I updated example-level docs, variant READMEs, and shared assets where needed.
- [ ] I ran `make format`.
- [ ] I ran `make lint`.
- [ ] I ran `make test`.
- [ ] I updated configuration files, samples ... when inputs changed.
- [ ] I updated tests, attack cases, or expected-behavior docs when behavior changed.
- [ ] I considered security, trust boundaries, and backward compatibility.
- [ ] If this adds a new example or variant, it documents what it builds, the attack, the insecure flow, the secure flow, the Anthale controls used, and how to run and test it.
